    i1 = input().strip().split()
    n, k = int(i1[0]), int(i1[1])
    i2 = input().strip().split()
    i3 = input().strip().split()
    b = [int(x) for x in i2]
    a = [int(x) for x in i3]
    p = [a[i]-b[i] for i in range(n)]
    p = sorted(p)
    d = 0
    sum = 0
    for i in b:
        sum+=i
        
    for i in reversed(p):
        if i < 0:
            break
        d += 1

        for i in p[0: n-d]:
            sum += i
        return

#    for i in p[n-k: n-d]:
#        sum -= i
#    print(sum)
    for i in p[0:n-k]:
        sum += i
    print(sum)
f()
